alt: 洪水後，一位家長帶著孩子和行李離開受損的住家，前往臨時收容處接受志工協助。
scene_prompt: Modern flood recovery scene: parent and child leaving damaged homes with suitcase, welcomed at temporary shelter by volunteers. Convey loss of home and displacement clearly, calm and safe. Natural anatomy, grounded feet, correct suitcase wheels.
